description: Route descriptions for routing-v1 (ADR 0122), written blind: none of the writers saw the evaluation set, so no description was fitted to its messages. Three sets, so a result does not rest on one wording. Each route is embedded as '<name>: <description>' (describedRouteText), the rendering ADR 0121 and ADR 0122 measured.

sets.name: blind1
sets.provenance: Written on 2026-10-09 by a separate agent that never saw the evaluation set. It was told only that it is the admin of a self-hosted AI chat product for a team of about 20, that each route has a name and a one-line description the router reads, that messages may be in English, German, French, Spanish or Swedish while descriptions are in English, and which routes use a cheaper model than the default. It was asked for one line of at most 20 words per route, written the way a busy admin would. Each of the three sets came from its own, independent agent.
